## Description {#details}

<p>This pass implements instructions packetization for <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/r600">R600</a>.</p>


<p>It unsets isLast bit of instructions inside a bundle and substitutes src register with PreviousVector when applicable.</p>
